notes: The 320x50 banner reads left to right as logo, quote, bottle. The logo sits centred on the muted circle, which acts as a badge. The gold quote mark leads into the two-line serif quote (10px), with the gold attribution (7px) underneath and left-aligned to the quote. The bottle is on the right on top of the warm sun circle. Both decorative circles are brought fully inside the canvas, and every element stays within a 2–4px margin of the edges.
